kernel_module_params.description: Runtime parameters for the Falco kernel driver (scap-dkms module). Adjust these only if you experience dropped events or need to tune resource usage.

buffers_per_cpu.description: Number of event buffers allocated per CPU. Increase if Falco logs show 'dropped events'.

prealloc_events.description: Number of events preallocated per CPU. Must be ≥ `buffers_per_cpu`.

capture_payloads.description: If true, capture full syscall payload (e.g., file paths, args). Disable to reduce overhead.

max_payload_size.description: Maximum bytes captured per payload (0 = unlimited). Set a limit to cap memory use.

max_concurrent_syscalls.description: Max in-flight syscalls tracked per CPU. Must be ≥ `buffers_per_cpu`.

enable_tracepoints.description: Enable tracepoint hooks (for bpftrace or advanced tracing). Usually not needed.

excluded_syscalls.description: List of syscall names to exclude from capture (e.g., ['open', 'stat']). Use only for noise reduction.

items.description: Syscall name to exclude (must be a valid Linux syscall)

enable_dedup.description: Enable deduplication of identical events (reduces log volume).

strict_mode.description: If true, the kernel module will refuse to load if any parameter is invalid.
